name: vishalm-claude-plugins
description: Personal marketplace of Claude Code plugins. Each plugin also ships a GitHub Copilot-compatible bundle under its own copilot/ folder for manual install into other repos.

plugins.name: code-review-local
plugins.description: Review a GitLab MR, GitHub PR, pasted MR/PR description, or local branch diff, using the same confidence-scored code-reviewer agent as robin's code-review-dev process — but reports findings only in this chat session and never posts a comment, review, or approval back to the MR/PR.
